info.title: Weakless Automation Engine API
info.description:
Multi-tenant automation infrastructure: workflows, AI agents, integrations, triggers, templates, billing.

Authenticate with `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` and, for tenant-scoped endpoints, `X-Organization-Id`. Errors use `{error: {code, message, details, request_id}}`. List endpoints accept `limit`/`offset` and return `{items, total, limit, offset}`.
